items.new_text: Each answer is a row tied to a form version. Changing the questionnaire preserves readable history: March responses remain interpretable after the September version.

Module 2 CRM rests on two decisions: form questions are rows, not columns (the cited Salesforce Lead had 353 fields, 304 custom), and scores are explainable through a new row for each calculation rather than overwriting history.

Each calculation gets a new row. `explicacao` stores the `{regra, versão, pontos}` array behind the number: it explains why a lead scored 74 and allows full recalculation after rule changes without losing history.
The band is the scoring engine's output and decides queue and owner.
Use `text` for CPF/CNPJ: alphanumeric CNPJ in 2026 breaks numeric columns and fixed digit masks.
Denormalized from `score_lead` because both fields are filtered frequently.
Store tenant custom fields here with a GIN index; never run `alter table` at runtime.

Forbidden words (migration 0042): the per-account list blocks agent sends (`referencias-blip/pesquisa/blip-desk-regras-tecnicas.md` section 3.4). Store `termo` as entered; the domain performs case- and accent-insensitive matching (`apps/api/src/dominio/gestao/palavras-proibidas.ts`).
Module 4 Management derives every metric from `evento_atendimento`, never from mutable conversation fields. This allows past periods to be recalculated when a metric definition changes.
Store the scale with each score so a CSAT 4 and NPS 4 do not end up summed in the same chart when a tenant uses both models.
Persisted class values: `promotor` | `neutro` | `detrator` for NPS; `satisfeito` | `insatisfeito` for CSAT.
Immutable and partitioned monthly on `em`; the primary key includes the partition key, as with `mensagem`.

Deterministic effort scale (spec section 4.4): 200 written characters/minute, 1,000 read characters/minute, and audio at 1x. `chars_de_resposta_pronta` discounts text the agent did not type, preventing templates and canned replies from inflating effort.

This tenant's Twenty instance and its access key.

One instance PER TENANT, per `docs/specs/2026-09-07-integracao-twenty.md` section 5: CRM isolation is physical, with no default instance. Null means the tenant has no CRM, so the integration does not run. Never silently fall back to another instance, which could send one tenant's data to another tenant's CRM.

`twentyChave` is an API key encrypted at rest with the Meta-token keyring (`PIPE_CHAVES_SEGREDO`). Unlike the Meta token, this key can READ the tenant's entire customer database.

Data a person supplies in "minha conta" after login.

All fields are nullable: a self-service account starts without them and the welcome screen explains that. Requiring them before login would recreate the pre-login form that self-service avoids. `funcionarios` is a text range such as "1 a 10", as in the source.
Null means onboarding is incomplete and Management sends the user to "minha conta".
Every business table references its tenant here. Keep this in identity rather than `comum` to avoid a circular import with `tenant` itself.
